svg.aria-label: Source-labelled triangular SUCC sheet by arithmetic time and Gamma grade
svg.text: q=6 SUCC: equilateral triangular sheet and Gamma rank shift
Exact lattice positions; colors encode grade/rank primitivity. Labels indicate symbolic source types, not numerical pi-normality.
Only n≥1, j≥0 is directly source-typed. Extending to the whole Euclidean plane requires an additional seam/clock convention.
